items.summary: Independent review: retain containment-only execution. Revenue evidence is limited to one dated aggregate window with no site-attributed commission; conflicting cost records and missing cost components block ROI, margin, forecasts, and spend decisions. Open failures, measurement work, and unevidenced security controls block new production work, requeues, experiments, dependencies, and monetization expansion. Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent pending counsel review and explicit authorization.

Approve only continuation of existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Preserve deferred opportunities without requeueing or creating duplicate telemetry. No new production proposal is supportable this cycle.
